messages:
alex_support: Hey team — customer reporting intermittent OAuth failures for users hitting our /auth/callback. Error logged: "invalid_state". Happens only when their flow goes through a URL shortener -> our CDN -> app. Example callback they pasted:

alex_support: https://app.example.com/auth/callback?code=abcd1234&state=xyz%2B123#_=_&state=xyz%2B123

alex_support: Obs: looks like duplicate state param (one in query, one appended after fragment rewrite), and in some cases the proxy rewrites the query order so pkce verifier != expected. Customer says 10% of logins fail across GH+Google SSO providers.

ops_bot: Noted and logged as incident INC-2026-142. Can we get the raw request headers/URI from the CDN logs?

jamal_eng: Can you paste repro steps? Also need the exact error we return and stacktrace if any. Might be our callback parser treating multiple state params as array and picking last.

alex_support: Repro steps from customer:
1) Start login via GitHub (web) or Google (mobile)
2) Redirect to shortener (they use bit.ly) -> expands to https://app.example.com/auth/callback?code=...&state=...
3) Their mobile webview adds a trailing fragment #_=_ for GH, the CDN normalizes fragments — sometimes it concatenates the fragment back into the query string, producing duplicate state

alex_support: Error returned to user: {"error":"invalid_state","message":"state mismatch"} and in logs we see: CallbackHandler: expected state "xyz+123" got "%5F%3D%5F" or sometimes an array ["xyz+123", "xyz+123"] which then fails our strict equality check.

sara_se: Ugh. I've seen similar: our URL-normalizer at the edge was merging fragments into query when rewriting for caching. Quick mitigation: accept if any of the state values equals session state. But that weakens checks a bit. Prefer: normalize before parsing (drop empty fragments, dedupe query params, decode percent-encoding consistently).

jamal_eng: Can we get a minimal patch: in CallbackHandler, when parsing query, if multiple state parameters exist, decode all and check any matches expected_state. Also log full raw_query for telemetry. Code sketch:

jamal_eng: ```
// pseudo
const states = parseQuery(req.url).state || []
const decoded = states.map(s => decodeURIComponent(s))
if (!decoded.includes(session.expectedState)) throw new Error('invalid_state')
```

john_customer: Confirmed — when I tested I got two state params after bit.ly expanded and our CDN did its redirect. After switching shortener off, login succeeded.

ops_bot: Added tag customer:acme-inc, priority:high. Recommend SRE to add CDN rule to preserve fragments or avoid merging into query.

alex_support: I'll push the quick patch to staging and send the customer a repro checklist. Will follow up with SRE for edge normalization.

sara_se: Also let's add an alert for >0.5% invalid_state per hour per org so we catch regression. :eyes:

jamal_eng: Agreed. I'll open PR for the tolerant check + telemetry; flagged for security review to ensure no replay risk.

alex_support: Thanks — assigning follow-ups: jamal PR, sara alerts, ops to check CDN config. Will update thread once validated in staging. :thumbsup:
